category: climate reanalysis and forecast archive (token-gated API)

free_tier.stated: Free data, account required: 'If you do not have an account yet, please register ... Once logged in, copy the code displayed below to the file $HOME/.cdsapirc' with url https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/api and a personal access token.
free_tier.notes: No price, no byte allowance and no quota is published on the API setup page.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a retrieval request returns a packaged file (NetCDF, GRIB or ZIP) built from the requested variable, area and period

retention.stated: the archive is the product: ERA5 and the other datasets are reissued, not deleted, and a retrieval result is held for a limited period before it must be re-requested
retention.notes: The result-retention window is not stated on the page read; do not treat this row as a measured value.

egress.terms: Free. The token is identity, not payment.

interface_detail: HTTPS API at https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/api with the cdsapi python client; the token goes in $HOME/.cdsapirc. Process listing at /api/retrieve/v1/processes.
tooling: cdsapi (pip install 'cdsapi>=0.7.7') is the vendor's own client; curl can drive the same endpoints with the PRIVATE-TOKEN header.
chaining: The only free ERA5-class reanalysis source; pair it with a compute sandbox because a full reanalysis pull is tens of GB and needs processing where it lands.

limits.value: no numeric limit published on the setup page; retrievals are queued server-side and the queue position is the observable wait

limits_note: The real gate is identity: registration plus a token plus, per dataset, a licence acceptance. The token is a credential and was not created here, so no retrieval was attempted.
binding_note: Nothing in the seven-kind vocabulary fails at 1 TiB/month that could be measured here; the gate that does fail is identity, which the vocabulary carries in identity_cost rather than in limits.

identity_cost.detail: A CDS account (email registration) plus a personal access token copied into .cdsapirc, plus a licence acceptance per dataset. No card and no institution.

reliability_note: Retrievals are queued and can take minutes to hours at peak; a client must poll a request id rather than expect a stream. No rate was measured because no token exists here.
confidence_note: The setup page was read and the process listing answered anonymously, which proves the service is live but not that a retrieval works. A retrieval with a real token would move this to measured.

evidence.proved: account registration, personal access token in $HOME/.cdsapirc, cdsapi>=0.7.7, url https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/api
200 with 25,713 bytes of JSON to an anonymous client - the process catalogue is public even though retrieval is not

notes: Caveat is the account and the queue, not the price. This is the clearest example of a resource that is free but not anonymous: the bytes cost nothing and the token is mandatory.
